name: Amoud Foundation
mission: Founded in 1998, the Amoud Foundation impacts the local and global communities by helping people help themselves through sustainable humanitarian projects while maintaining trusting relationships. Amoud is an international humanitarian organization that today serves the people in the Horn of Africa. Amoud also does work on the home-front including helping with the 2006 Hurricane Relief and 2015 Garland Tornado recovery.

strengths_deep_dive: Amoud Foundation demonstrates a high level of financial health, characterized by its ability to keep costs low while maximizing output. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="15">$9,535,194 in total revenue</cite> from contributions. Their <cite id="16">program expense ratio of 89.3%</cite> (as used for scoring) reflects a deep commitment to field operations. Furthermore, the foundation's <cite id="17">working capital of 12.7 months</cite> ensures they can sustain operations during economic fluctuations. This financial discipline is paired with a long history of service, having been <cite id="18">founded in 1998</cite>, which provides a reliable track record for donors.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1998, Amoud Foundation is a humanitarian organization focused on providing direct aid to vulnerable populations in Somalia and Somaliland. The charity operates with a mission to <cite id="1">assist 15 orphan centers and schools for the deaf and blind</cite>, ensuring that basic needs like food and healthcare are met for those in crisis. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="2">$11,142,566 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting a steady <cite id="3">3-year revenue growth rate of 9.0%</cite>. This growth allows the foundation to maintain its commitment to <cite id="4">direct service delivery</cite> rather than just advocacy. The organization is <cite id="5">explicitly Zakat-eligible</cite>, making it a key partner for Muslim donors looking to fulfill their religious obligations through <cite id="6">food packages and healthcare programs</cite>. Financial management is a notable strength, as the charity maintains <cite id="7">12.7 months of working capital</cite> in working capital, providing significant long-term stability. While the foundation has a strong track record of over 25 years, it maintains a lean operation with <cite id="8">fundraising efficiency of just $0.03 to raise every $1</cite>. This ensures that the vast majority of donor contributions are utilized for program activities rather than administrative overhead.
